[
  "The licensed guideline corpus contains no recommendation for the condition 'NEV'.",
  "Formal dermatology guidelines focus on malignant and pre‑malignant lesions.",
  "The absence of a recommendation for 'NEV' represents a coverage boundary of the corpus, not a retrieval failure.",
  "The contingency condition 'MEL' (melanoma) is covered by the licensed guideline corpus.",
  "According to PMID 30392755, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.",
  "The same PMID 30392755 recommends surgical excision for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "According to PMID 30392755, sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor when indicated.",
  "The sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as the wide excision whenever possible.",
  "According to PMID 39709737, when melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for the recommendation in PMID 39709737 is 100% (21/21)."
]
